purpose: Present native display dimensions to the shared world-HUD Scaleform producer while the scene remains reduced for DLSS Quality

location.layout: Four aligned 32-bit graphics-state fields: current width/height followed by prior width/height; game state begins at RVA 0x328cc20

original: Every field must match the active reduced scene extent: render width, render height, render width, render height. The observed 1707x960 value has little-endian bytes ab060000c0030000ab060000c0030000; other validated render extents are accepted by exact value, not by wildcard bytes.
replacement: Native display width, height, width, height, written only inside NativeHudDimensions windows around the original HUD PostDisplay and Scaleform EndFrame calls
abi: Data-only DWORD writes. No instructions, calling convention, registers, stack or unwind state are replaced. Existing menu and EndFrame relays continue to forward each original exactly once.
activation: Exact game hash and verified graphics-state base, native UI phase on owning render thread, DLSS SR output, two identical reduced pairs, native dimensions larger than reduced, writable non-guard page; title, inventory and magic paths excluded.
lifetime: Each original UI call is bracketed on the render thread; native dimension values exist only for that call and the reduced values are restored before return.
recovery: RAII restoration runs on scope exit. Each field is restored only if it still matches the value written by RazKolbas; an intervening writer's different value is preserved and logged. A failed gate writes nothing. Disable the experimental rendering hooks or use SafeMode on the next launch to prevent activation.
